blind_to.J_nat: how 'natural' positions are defined (next-token identity; contexts where the target is predicted but not emitted); E6 flagged it as weak on emoticon
blind_to.recovery: trigger windows only; interactions between gate changes at different positions (rho_trig measures how much sits at the trigger). Positive control for the leak reading: rho_trig itself (per-window values do recover). Null: the random moved shift

expected.W0_gates: recovery 0 exactly (trig with W0's gates; shared with a zero shift)
expected.r: emoticon 0.60, r1_t534 0.75, r2_t359 0.28 (seed 1 within ~0.05 of seed 0)

filed: 2026-10-21, before any run; plan reports/2026-10-21_plan_regating-leak.md (Predictions, build notes)

gate.rule: seed 0: |r - ref| <= 0.05 on emoticon (ref 0.5965, E6 ft_s0) and <= 0.1 on r1_t534 (ref 0.7461) and r2_t359 (ref 0.2844; E5's do-nothing at step 10, the delta-W E11 regenerated); gain >= 1; recovery with W0's gates |.| <= 1e-6

measurements.J_nat: Jaccard of S_on (seed 0) with the top-|S_on| alive subcomponents by W0's gate contrast (mean g at positions whose next token is the target minus mean g over all positions) on Pile ('val', 0, 600); random: mean Jaccard of 20 random_like sets with the same top set
measurements.r: (L01 - L00) / (T1 - T0) on the held-out windows' trigger log-odds of the target; L = CI-masked model, C0
measurements.random: S_on = alive subcomponents whose shared change > 0.3; the shared change's values on S_on moved onto 20 random same-size-per-matrix sets outside S_on (recruit.random_like seeds 0..19), recovery mean
measurements.recovery: (lo_pattern - L00) / (L01 - L00); every pattern is W0's gates except at the trigger position
measurements.rho_cross: the null fine-tune's shared change, read at this task's target and divided by this task's gap
measurements.rho_mean: the state's mean trigger gates over the training windows, for every window (reported; rho_mean_W0, the same with W0's mean, is its reference)
measurements.rho_shared: W0's per-window trigger gates + mean over the training windows of (state - W0) trigger gates (alive subcomponents; dead 0), clipped to [0, 1]
measurements.rho_trig: the state's own per-window gates at the trigger

predictions.rule: rho_trig >= 0.7 on every task and seed

predictions.predicted: pass on emoticon with confidence; pass on the ladder tasks with low confidence; a fail on the ladder tasks only is the mixed branch
predictions.rule: rho_shared >= 0.7 rho_trig on every task and seed, and the random mean <= 0.1
rho_cross <= 0.1 on every task and seed

predictions.conditional_on: >= 200 natural positions in 600 rows for the task
predictions.predicted: pass on the ladder tasks, uncertain on emoticon
predictions.rule: J_nat (seed 0) >= 3 x the random mean on every task

reported_not_scored: rho_mean and rho_mean_W0; |S_on| per task and seed, by layer; Jaccard of S_on across seeds and with the null's S_on; the null's held-out P(' http'); J_nat at seed 1; the adversary's turned-down share (source < 0.5) of S_on vs of all alive, at the state and at W0 (20 steps, seed 0, Pile ('val', 0, 64))
scorable: P1 to P3 read only the task-seed states with gain >= 1.0 nat and re-gating gap L01 - L00 >= 0.5 nats (the others are reported); P4 reads only tasks with >= 200 natural positions, and is unscored if none has
states: do-nothing placement of the step-10 arm-A fine-tune (Adam 3e-5, batch 32, 10 steps): target W0 + delta-W, released subcomponents C0, Gamma frozen, Delta out of the masked model. Seed 0 = E11's saved delta-W, seed 1 trained in the job. Null: the same recipe to ' http' (token 3944), seed 0. Tasks emoticon (target 'o'), r1_t534_v369 (' which' -> ' was'), r2_t359_v816 (' we' -> ' just')
